## My Cycle 1.3.0

### Privacy, backup and daily use
- Added CSV import with validation, duplicate-date preview and confirmation before matching dates are replaced.
- Added versioned `.mycycle` full backup and restore for diary records and app settings, with rollback if restore cannot complete safely.
- Restored device-specific biometric lock and reminder enablement stay off until the user explicitly enables them on the current device.
- Added optional daily local reminders with a configurable time and privacy-conscious notification text.
- Added optional biometric app lock on Android 9+ and optional screenshot/recent-apps protection.
- Added a privacy-safe “Log today” launcher shortcut and home-screen widget for quick diary access.
- Refreshed the adaptive launcher artwork with a warmer cycle/calendar/petal design.
- Hardened reminder intents and validation of system file-picker URIs used by import, export and backup operations.

My Cycle remains offline-first: there is no account, cloud synchronization, analytics or Android `INTERNET` permission. Data leaves the app only when you explicitly create a CSV export or `.mycycle` backup.
